description: From-scratch full-input cyclic BWT, delayed half-move rank list, bijective zero-run coding, run/rank binary tree, and adaptive binary range coding. Mixture weights 3:3:2 combine previous-three-rank, front-character, and previous-rank models. Sixteen inverse chains are interleaved on one core. Bounds checked malloc/free decoder links only libc; nonloaded ELF section metadata stripped.
name: bwt-delayed-half-front-mixed-range
